concerns.text: T026/T028 implement generic 'statistical functions' and 'analysis pipeline' but fail to explicitly implement the Point-Biserial correlation and paired t-test mandated by FR-005. This is a semantic weakening of the requirement to a generic statistical task.

Plan.md explicitly selects a Linear Mixed Effects (LME) model to handle nested data (responses within prompts) as a complexity tracking decision, yet tasks.md Phase 5 contains no task to implement an LME model. This drops a critical methodological constraint from the plan.

FR-003 requires generating up to 3 distinct candidate responses per prompt and flagging incomplete prompts. T014/T017 describe inference and formatting but lack explicit tasks for the multi-generation loop and the 'incomplete' flagging logic, risking a failure to capture the variance required for the rigidity analysis.

FR-004 and FR-008 require the scoring model to be pre-fine-tuned on diverse scientific reasoning and validated against a gold standard. T020 only describes 'Loading and freezing' an existing model. No task exists to perform the actual fine-tuning of the proxy model, leaving the core assumption of the scoring mechanism unimplemented.

FR-007 requires recording generation failures, truncations, and scoring ambiguities (variance > 1.5 or entropy > 2.0) in a separate audit log. T016 ('Add logging') and T032 ('Low-confidence flagging') are vague and do not explicitly mandate the creation of a structured audit log artifact or the specific logic to capture entropy/variance metrics for exclusion from analysis.

FR-002 and FR-006 require CPU-only inference with specific batch_size=1 and temperature=0.7 constraints. T014/T015 do not explicitly state the enforcement of these hyperparameters or the fallback mechanism (e.g., to INT4) described in the spec's edge cases, risking an OOM crash on the GitHub Actions runner.
